title: Cloud Cuckoo Land
author: Anthony Doerr
summary: Stories set in fifteenth-century Constantinople, a present-day Idaho library and a future spaceship are linked by an ancient Greek tale of a shepherd who wants to reach a city in the clouds. Each hinges on a book.
readIf: you like big, interwoven historical and speculative stories that celebrate libraries and reading.
skipIf: you dislike jumping between many timelines, because it takes a while for the threads to meet.

pairings.reason: The same author's earlier, very tender novel of intertwined lives during war.
Another book of linked stories across different eras, with sharper formal games.
A more dreamlike and fantastical celebration of stories and the places that keep them.
